# Zachary Leifer — zacharyleifer.com

> Zachary Leifer is a senior commercial growth executive (CMO, CCO) based in Las Vegas, NV.
> Former CMO at 1/ST Technology (67% revenue growth, 22% EBITDA CAGR over four years), CCO at
> PokerAtlas, and VP at Las Vegas Sands / The Venetian ($36M direct revenue from $13M investment).
> Harvard Business School Advanced Management Program graduate. Open to board director, advisory,
> and senior operating roles in gaming, hospitality, technology, and consumer industries.
